title: BJYM, police scuffle during a protest against Revenue Minister in Shimla

ai.summary: BJYM activists protested in Shimla against Revenue Minister Jagat Singh Negi's remarks on Operation Sindoor, leading to a scuffle with police as they attempted to burn his effigy. Police intervened when protesters tried to set fire to the minister's effigy, resulting in a brief clash.

facts.claim: Hundreds of BJYM members gathered outside the Deputy Commissioner’s office, raising slogans against the minister and demanding his resignation
facts.quote: Hundreds of BJYM members gathered outside the Deputy Commissioner’s office, raising slogans against the minister and demanding his resignation

facts.claim: A scuffle broke out between Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) activists and police personnel when protesters attempted to burn the effigy of Revenue Minister Jagat Singh Negi during a demonstration against his remarks on Operation Sindoor made during the recent Winter Session of the Himachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly
facts.quote: A scuffle broke out between Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) activists and police personnel when protesters attempted to burn the effigy of Revenue Minister Jagat Singh Negi during a demonstration against his remarks on Operation Sindoor made during the recent Winter Session of the Himachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly

facts.claim: As the protesters moved to burn Negi’s effigy, police personnel deployed at the site intervened
facts.quote: As the protesters moved to burn Negi’s effigy, police personnel deployed at the site intervened

facts.claim: The protesters resisted, leading to a brief scuffle between the two sides
facts.quote: The protesters resisted, leading to a brief scuffle between the two sides

facts.claim: BJYM state general secretary Sushil Kadasholi, along with several BJP and Yuva Morcha leaders and workers, participated in the protest
facts.quote: BJYM state general secretary Sushil Kadasholi, along with several BJP and Yuva Morcha leaders and workers, participated in the protest

facts.claim: Addressing the gathering, Kadasholi termed Negi’s remarks on the Indian Army and Operation Sindoor as "extremely unfortunate and condemnable"
facts.quote: Addressing the gathering, Kadasholi termed Negi’s remarks on the Indian Army and Operation Sindoor as "extremely unfortunate and condemnable"

facts.claim: The entire country is proud of the valour of the Indian Army. Therefore, comments questioning the Army’s valour are unbecoming of a person holding a responsible constitutional position
facts.quote: The entire country is proud of the valour of the Indian Army. Therefore, comments questioning the Army’s valour are unbecoming of a person holding a responsible constitutional position

facts.claim: Kadasholi alleged that the minister had abandoned political decorum and restraint
facts.quote: Kadasholi alleged that the minister had abandoned political decorum and restraint

facts.claim: He should publicly apologise to the people of the country and the Indian Army for his remarks and immediately resign from the Council of Ministers on moral grounds
facts.quote: He should publicly apologise to the people of the country and the Indian Army for his remarks and immediately resign from the Council of Ministers on moral grounds

facts.claim: Condemning the police action, Kadasholi alleged that the force was acting under pressure from the state government and attempting to suppress the voices of activists
facts.quote: Condemning the police action, Kadasholi alleged that the force was acting under pressure from the state government and attempting to suppress the voices of activists

facts.claim: He said peaceful protest was a fundamental democratic right and any attempt to curb it was highly condemnable
facts.quote: He said peaceful protest was a fundamental democratic right and any attempt to curb it was highly condemnable

ai.background_note: BJYM activists protested in Shimla against Revenue Minister Jagat Singh Negi's remarks on Operation Sindoor, leading to a scuffle with police as they attempted to burn his effigy.
